sections.text:
Several SEO service providers offer monthly subscriptions under $150, providing cost-effective solutions compared to traditional $2,000 retainers. Here are some options to consider:


[SNS運用はAIエージェントの時代へ。ADKが「SOCIAI（ソシアイ）」の提供を開始 | O!Product AI](https://oproduct.ai/articles/6697742?utm_source=openai)
**Socio AI**  
Offers HVAC-specific SEO services at $150 per month, including Google Business Profile optimization, bilingual website development, blog content, review generation, and local SEO execution. ([socio-ai.com](https://socio-ai.com/hvac-seo-services?utm_source=openai))



[Davis Studio VT | Art Classes & Camps for Kids, Teens & Adults](https://davisstudiovt.com/?utm_source=openai)
**Dravis Studio**  
Provides an 'SEO Starter' package at $150 per month, featuring a website audit, basic on-page SEO for up to 5 pages, optimization for 5 keywords, and monthly progress reports. ([dravisstudio.com](https://dravisstudio.com/landing-page/?utm_source=openai))



[Entrust net Logo PNG Transparent & SVG Vector - Freebie Supply](https://freebiesupply.com/logos/entrust-net-logo/?utm_source=openai)
**Enter.Net**  
Offers a 'Local/Organic SEO' package at $150 per month, including initial website SEO setup, keyword and meta description updates, and optimization for up to 10 pages with 5-10 locations. ([enter.net](https://enter.net/services/search-engine-optimization?utm_source=openai))



[Ikon Pass Prices Go up May 5. Here’s What You Need to Know If You’re on the Fence. - Newschoolers.com](https://www.newschoolers.com/news/read/Ikon-Pass-Prices-5-Herea-Youa-Fence?utm_source=openai)
**PeakRanking Digital Solutions**  
Provides small business web design and SEO services starting at $150 per month, covering design, development, hosting, unlimited edits, 24/7 support, and lifetime updates. ([peakrankingseo.com](https://peakrankingseo.com/?utm_source=openai))




**Akash SEO**  
Offers a 'Local SEO Plan' at $150 per month, including SEO analysis, on-page and technical SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, content creation (1x 1000 words), link building (10 backlinks), and monthly reports. ([akashseo.com](https://akashseo.com/pricing/?utm_source=openai))


These providers offer a range of services tailored to different business needs, all priced below traditional retainer fees.
